responsibility: Declares the Rust backend’s constexpr support entry points exposed to the rest of lowering. In practice it publishes the expression-folder and constexpr-function-save hooks used when compiling const items and const functions, acting as the narrow public interface to the larger constant-evaluation implementation.
same_name_distinction: Provides the minimal public declarations for constexpr support used elsewhere in the backend, notably expression folding and saving constexpr function definitions. Unlike rust-constexpr.cc, it exposes only the narrow interface, not the embedded constant-evaluation machinery.
